Bash(node -e "const fs=require\('fs'\),path=require\('path'\);function walk\(d\){return fs.readdirSync\(d\).flatMap\(f=>{const p=path.join\(d,f\);return fs.statSync\(p\).isDirectory\(\)?walk\(p\):p.endsWith\('.html'\)?[p]:[]}\)}const files=walk\('dist'\);let broken=[],checked=0;for\(const f of files\){const html=fs.readFileSync\(f,'utf8'\);const hrefs=[...html.matchAll\(/href=\\"\([^\\"]+\)\\"/g\)].map\(m=>m[1]\);for\(const h of hrefs\){if\(h.startsWith\('http'\)||h.startsWith\('mailto:'\)||h.startsWith\('tel:'\)\)continue;checked++;const [pathPart,frag]=h.split\('#'\);let resolved;if\(pathPart===''||pathPart===undefined\)resolved=f;else if\(pathPart.startsWith\('/'\)\)resolved=path.join\('dist',pathPart==='/'?'index.html':pathPart\);else resolved=path.resolve\(path.dirname\(f\),pathPart\);if\(resolved&&!resolved.endsWith\('.html'\)&&!resolved.endsWith\('.png'\)&&!resolved.endsWith\('.css'\)&&!resolved.endsWith\('.js'\)&&!resolved.endsWith\('.ico'\)\)resolved=path.join\(resolved,'index.html'\);if\(resolved&&!fs.existsSync\(resolved\)\)broken.push\({src:f,href:h,resolved}\)}}console.log\('checked',checked,'broken',broken.length\);broken.forEach\(b=>console.log\(' BROKEN',b.src,'->',b.href\)\);process.exit\(broken.length===0?0:1\)")
